description: Defines enums, structs, and functions for escaping strings in various modes and platforms, used for shell commands, Ninja files, and JSON data.

methods.name: EscapeString
methods.description: Escapes the input string according to the specified options, returning the escaped string.

methods.name: EscapeStringToStream
methods.description: Writes the escaped string to the provided output stream.

methods.name: EscapeJSONStringToStream
methods.description: Escapes a string for JSON and writes it to the output stream.
